name: Notarangelo Showroom
summary: Welcome to an exciting VR experience that takes us back to the 1970s, immersing us in a magical darkroom. The art of photography comes to life as we explore timeless images and listen to the tale of a young man and his friend Mimi. This sensory journey includes the mystical atmosphere of the red light bulb and the smell of Tuscan cigars. The photographs depict ordinary people, considered heroes by the young man's father, who wanted to preserve their memory. The experience invites us to reflect on modernity
